2607.09121.title: Augmenting Fundamental Analysis with Large Language Models: A RAG-Based System for Generating Investor Briefs
2607.09121.paper_summary: In this study, we examine the opportunities brought by Large Language Models (LLMs) to various aspects of fundamental analysis of companies based on their reports as well as data and documents describing macroeconomic situation like GDP and inflation changes as well as documents filled to the U.S. Securities and Exchange Commission (SEC) which can be found in EDGAR. We were preprocessing those data and than sending via API to gpt-4o model in a Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) like regime. We prepared as well a document describing an exemplar investor knowledge based on Kitchin cycles. We were scanning data important for analysis of 9 companies for 4 weeks. Using LLM we were producing automatic briefs about them. They were sent to nine participants who are individual investors to evaluate usefulness of such approach to data analysis.
2607.09121.paper_summary_zh: 在這項研究中，我們檢視大型語言模型（LLMs）為公司基本面分析帶來的機會，這些分析基於公司的報告以及描述宏觀經濟情況的數據和文件，例如GDP和通脹變化，以及提交給美國證券交易委員會（SEC）的文件，這些文件可以在EDGAR中找到。<lb/>我們對這些數據進行了預處理，然後通過API發送到gpt-4o模型，採用檢索增強生成（RAG）類似的模式。<lb/>我們還準備了一份描述基於基奇循環的示例投資者知識的文件。<lb/>我們掃描了9家公司重要的數據，持續了4週。<lb/>使用LLM，我們自動生成了有關它們的簡報。<lb/>這些簡報發送給九位個人投資者，以評估這種數據分析方法的實用性。
